title: Broadcom's stock drops 5% as weak guidance overshadows earnings beat - cnbc.com
snippet: * Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter. Broadcom shares dropped 5% in extended trading on Wednesday after the chipmaker issued disappointing guidance for the current quarter. For the fiscal fourth quarter, Broadcom said it expects revenue of $34.8 billion, while analysts were expecting $35.03 billion, according to LSEG. Broadcom's revenue increased 86% during the quarter from $15.95 billion a year ago, according to a statement. Net income more than tripled to $13.09 billion, or $2.68 per share, from $4.14 billion, or 85 cents per share a year earlier. As of Wednesday's close, Broadcom shares had gained about 6% in 2026, while the S&P 500 index is up 12% in the same period. During the quarter, Broadcom touted the custom Jalapeno chip it developed with OpenAI, while Apple said it would spend more with Broadcom for U.S. chip production. **WATCH:** What to expect from Broadcom's Q3.
